Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector FS X-Sector Specialism Operations Management Level Associate Job Description & Summary A career in our Investigations and Fact Finding practice, within Fraud, Investigations and Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE) services, will provide you with the opportunity to help our clients understand where they might have vulnerabilities and develop solutions to manage the risks involved. We prevent, respond to and remediate a wide range of business threats, risks and complex issues. Our team helps businesses detect and investigate fraudulent activities or irregularities within their organisation. As part of our team, you’ll help investigate issues such as corporate irregularities, whistleblower allegations, asset misappropriation, regulatory violations, patent and copyright infringement and financial reporting fraud. Job Title: KYC –Associate Company: Pw C India Location: Bangalore Job Type: Full-time Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled KYC Analyst with 3-6 years of experience to join our dynamic team in the Financial Crime Compliance. The ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting thorough due diligence on clients by gathering and analyzing client information to verify compliance with regulatory requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Conduct client due diligence (CDD) to gather information such as identity verification, source of funds, and beneficial ownership for different entity types like Banks, Trust, Funds, SPV etc. Perform initial checks on client documents and data to ensure completeness and accuracy. Support in conducting research using various databases and sources to verify client information. Evaluate based on client risk levels which includes business activities, geographic location, and other relevant factors. Conduct sanction screening and adverse media screening of customers using specialized tools and databases and analyze screening results to identify matches with sanctioned individuals, entities, or countries. Maintain accurate documentation for all clients, including KYC profiles and ongoing monitoring records. Conduct reviews for ongoing monitoring of client accounts, including periodic reviews and event driven reviews. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to address KYC-related issues and provide guidance on regulatory requirements. Continuously evaluate and enhance KYC processes and procedures to improve efficiency and strengthen compliance controls. Stay updated on regulatory requirements related to KYC, AML, and CFT. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field. 3-6 years of experience in KYC, AML compliance, or a related role within the banking industry. Strong understanding of financial regulations, including but not limited to Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements. Experienced analyst with a in depth-knowledge of financial products, services, and industry regulations. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and identify potential risks. Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management abilities. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly and concisely. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in using KYC tools, databases, and software applications for conducting due diligence and risk assessments.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Professional certifications such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE). Experience working with large-scale banking or financial institutions. Familiarity with regulatory requirements specific to the jurisdiction in which the bank operates. Job Description

Job Description & Summary:

We are seeking a skilled AWS Infrastructure and Dev Ops Engineer to design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines on AWS. The resource will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to automate deployments, ensure system reliability, and optimize cloud resources. The ideal candidate has strong experience in AWS, infrastructure as code, automation, and Dev Ops best practices.

Job Position Title:


IN_ Associate _ AWS Devops Engineer _One cloud_Mumbai

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available AWS infrastructure.

- Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) scripts using Terraform, Cloud Formation, or AWS CDK.

- Build, monitor, and improve CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Code Pipeline, Code Build, or other tools.

- Automate server provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes.

- Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using Cloud Watch, Cloud Trail, and third-party tools.

- Ensure security best practices are applied, including IAM policies, network security groups, and data encryption.

- Collaborate with development teams to optimize application deployment and performance on AWS.

- Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues promptly and implement fixes.

- Maintain documentation related to infrastructure setup, CI/CD workflows, and operational procedures.

Mandatory skill sets:

- Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing AWS infrastructure (EC2, VPC, ELB, RDS, S3, IAM, Cloud Watch).

- Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools: Terraform, Cloud Formation, or AWS CDK.

- Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, AWS Code Pipeline, Git Lab CI/CD, Circle CI.

- Proficient with container technologies: Docker, Amazon ECS, EKS (Kubernetes).

- Scripting and automation expertise using Python, Bash, or Power Shell.

- Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Chef, or Puppet is a plus.

- Understanding networking concepts: DNS, TCP/IP, VPN, Load Balancers, Security Groups, NACLs.

- Knowledge of security best practices in cloud environments.

- Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Cloud Watch, Cloud Trail, ELK stack).

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred skill sets:

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer.

- Experience with serverless architecture (AWS Lambda, API Gateway).

- Familiarity with Agile and Dev Ops methodologies.

Years of experience required:

· 2 to 4 years

Education qualification:

· BE/ Btech/ Mtech/ MCA/ MBA (fulltime)

title: Associate Employee Relation Human Capital IFS Kolkata
jobDescription:
Job Profile: At Pw C, our people in people strategy focus on developing and implementing long-term strategies to align the organisation's human capital with its overall business objectives. This involves analysing workforce trends, applying the latest HR strategy, long-term workforce planning and improving overall employee experience. In business partnering at Pw C, you will focus on strategic consulting with business stakeholders, advising on people strategies, policies and programmes to achieve current and future business objectives and overcome people related challenges. You will work collaboratively with the wider HR team to shape the Firm’s people strategy and priorities based on their understanding of the business as well as influence the business alignment with and adoption of firmwide direction.

Job Role:
The Senior Associate– Employee Relations will act as a strategic partner to the business and HR leadership, responsible for managing complex employee relations matters, conducting investigations, advising leadership on people risk, and ensuring compliance with employment laws and organizational policies.

This role plays a critical part in maintaining a fair, compliant, and high-trust workplace by managing high-risk ER cases, advising senior leaders, strengthening ER governance frameworks, and driving proactive employee relations initiatives across the organization.
RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Employee Relations Case Management
• Lead and resolve complex and high-risk employee relations cases including misconduct, grievance, performance disputes, disciplinary actions,
• Conduct end-to-end workplace investigations/ due diligence including fact-finding, interviews, documentation, and recommendation of corrective actions.
• Ensure consistent application of policies and procedures while maintaining fairness, confidentiality, and legal compliance.

2. Advisory to Business Leaders
• Serve as a trusted advisor to HR Business Partners, senior leadership, and people managers on employee relations matters.
• Provide guidance on disciplinary processes, performance management, terminations, restructuring, and sensitive employee issues.
• Assist HC leader to Coach leaders on conflict resolution, difficult conversations, and people management practices.

3. Risk Management & Compliance
• Ensure adherence to employment laws, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
• Identify, assess, and mitigate employee-related risks across business units.
• Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Ethics teams on complex investigations or litigation risks.

4. ER Framework, Governance & Policy
• Support the design and implementation of ER governance frameworks, processes, and policies across the organization.
• Drive consistent ER practices across service lines and business units.
• Conduct periodic reviews of policies to ensure compliance with labor laws and evolving workplace standards.

5. Organizational Change & Workforce Matters
• Support business restructuring, workforce transitions, redundancy processes, and organizational changes.
• Provide ER support during large-scale workforce actions or sensitive business changes.

title: Business Application Consulting - Oracle Finance - Senior Associate - CS - G
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is a leading professional services firm helping organizations solve complex business problems. Within Pw C, the Emerging Businesses unit acts as the incubation and innovation engine. We focus on building next-generation digital products, platforms, and enterprise solutions using disruptive technologies.

As a Gen AI Developer in this team, you will work at the intersection of business strategy and cutting-edge technology. You will design and implement state-of-the-art Generative AI solutions that drive transformation for Pw C and our marquee clients across diverse industries.

Job Position Title:

IN_Senior Associate_Gen AI developer _Emerging Business_Advisory_Bangalore (India)

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Solution Development: Develop and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI applications, APIs, and microservices.

· LLM Orchestration & RAG: Optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and advanced search architectures to ground LLMs on proprietary enterprise data.

· Agentic AI: Build multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using orchestration frameworks to automate complex, multi-step business processes.

· Model Integration: Integrate leading commercial and foundational models via enterprise cloud environments (Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI / Model Garden).

· Responsible AI & Guardrails: Implement safety guidelines, content moderation, data privacy controls, and guardrails to ensure compliant and ethical AI deployments. Establish evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance (latency, accuracy, bias, drift, and cost) and set up monitoring in production.

· Client Collaboration & Po Cs: Rapidly prototype Proof of Concepts (Po Cs) to showcase Gen AI capabilities to internal leaders and external clients.

Mandatory skill sets:

· 3–6 years of experience in software development with strong computer science fundamentals.

· Expert Python Programming: Deep proficiency in Python and its standard libraries.

· API Development: Experience building robust and secure RESTful/Graph QL APIs using frameworks like Fast API, Flask, or Django.

· Cloud Ecosystems (Any One Preferred): Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform’s AI ecosystem:

· GCP: Vertex AI, Vertex AI Search and Conversation, Vertex AI Model Garden, Gemini API, Google ADK.

· Microsoft Azure: Azure Open AI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, AI Foundry

· AWS: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Sage Maker.

· Databases: Proficiency in SQL and No SQL databases.

· Frameworks: Extensive experience with Lang Chain, Llama Index or Lang Graph.

· Vector Databases & Search: Practical experience with vector databases/search engines such as Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, Vertex AI Vector Search, or Azure AI Search.

· Prompt Engineering: Proven ability in designing complex system prompts, few-shot learning, and chain-of-thought prompting.

· Embeddings: Deep understanding of text embeddings, semantic search, and advanced chunking strategies.

· 3. Dev Ops & LLMOps

· Containerization using Docker and basic understanding of Kubernetes (e.g., GKE, AKS, or EKS).

· Experience with Git-based CI/CD pipelines.

· Familiarity with LLM monitoring tools (e.g., Lang Smith, Langfuse or Arize Phoenix).

Preferred skill sets:

· Experience in Fine-tuning models (PEFT, Lo RA) using Hugging Face libraries.

· Knowledge of Graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) for Graph RAG implementations.

· Familiarity with UI prototyping frameworks like Streamlit, Chainlit, or Gradio.

· An understanding of MLOps pipelines on GCP (Vertex AI Pipelines), Azure, or AWS.

Years of experience required:

· 4- 7 years

Education qualification:

· BE/ Btech/ Mtech/ MCA/ MBA (fulltime)

title: Data and Analytics Engineering - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Senior Associate - CS - G
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI (Gen AI) Specialist with hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying Gen AI applications in production environments. This technical role focuses on leveraging advanced AI technologies to build scalable and efficient models, improve business processes, and deliver innovative AI-driven solutions.

Job Position Title: IN_Senior Associate_Gen AI_D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and deploy generative AI applications using state-of-the-art models and frameworks in production environments.
  • Implement AI solutions leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, Lang Chain, and multimodal AI techniques.
  • Optimize and monitor AI models using MLOps / LLMOps best practices for scalable and reliable deployment.
  • Apply statistical, data mining, and deep learning techniques including regression, decision trees, boosting, CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and other neural networks.
  • Conduct advanced text analytics encompassing NLP, NLU, and NLG for robust AI-driven insights.
  • Fine-tune pre-trained large language models (LLMs) such as GPT, LLa MA, and Claude using Lo RA, QLo RA, and PEFT methodologies.

Mandatory skill sets:

  • Hands-on experience in generative AI application design, development, and production deployment.
  • Strong knowledge of RAG, vector databases, Lang Chain, and multimodal AI applications.
  • Expertise in deep learning architectures (CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformers) and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in Python and R, including distributed computing tools and IDEs.
  • Experience in advanced NLP/NLU/NLG techniques and text analytics.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps and MLOps frameworks for model lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of Py Torch, Tensor Flow, and generative AI services like Open AI and Google Gemini.
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques for large language models using Lo RA, QLo RA, and PEFT.
  • Understanding of agentic AI frameworks such as Lang Graph and Auto Gen.

Preferred skill sets:

  • Experience with scalable AI deployment using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools like Apache Spark, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory.
  • Domain knowledge in relevant industries like finance, healthcare, or supply chain for contextual AI applications.

Years of experience required: 4-7 Years

Education qualification: BE, B.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Tech

Pw C India is seeking a highly skilled .NET Core / Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing scalable enterprise applications. This is a technical role focused on delivering robust web and API solutions leveraging .NET Core, modern frontend frameworks, and cloud technologies to meet complex business needs.

Job Position Title: IN_Senior Associate_.NET Core Full Stack_D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and APIs using .NET Core and full stack technologies.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly front-end interfaces with frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js integrated with backend services.
  • Develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and backend components ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical designs and solutions.
  • Implement unit tests, integration tests, and participate in code reviews to ensure software quality and maintainability.
  • Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability while ensuring cross-platform compatibility.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues and implement continuous improvements.
  • Integrate applications with external systems and enterprise data sources using APIs, messaging queues, and cloud services.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, design specifications, and test cases.
  • Stay updated with latest .NET Core technologies, frontend frameworks, and cloud trends like Azure or AWS to continuously enhance solutions.

  • Proficiency in frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js for full stack development.
  • Expertise in C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server or other relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful API design, security best practices (OAuth2, JWT), and application architecture patterns.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies.

Preferred skill sets:

  • Familiarity with Dev Ops tools, infrastructure as code (Terraform/ARM templates), and automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to Azure Dev Ops, AWS Code Pipeline, or Jenkins for build and release management.
  • Understanding of overall software development lifecycle and data governance principles.

Years of experience required: 4-7 Years

Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is seeking a highly skilled Playwright QA Engineer with hands-on experience in designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts using Playwright. This is a technical role focused on delivering robust test automation solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of web applications in complex enterprise environments.

Job Position Title: IN_Senior Associate_Playwright QA_D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks using Playwright to validate web applications across multiple browsers and platforms.
  • Collaborate with development and QA teams to identify test requirements and translate them into comprehensive test automation suites.
  • Develop end-to-end test scenarios including UI, functional, regression, and performance testing using Playwright.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster release cycles.
  • Execute, debug, and troubleshoot test failures; analyze root causes and work with development teams to resolve issues.
  • Maintain and update test cases and automation scripts based on application changes and new feature releases.
  • Ensure best practices for test automation including code reviews, version control, and test data management.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation including test plans, test cases, and automation framework architecture.
  • Stay updated with latest trends and advancements in Playwright, test automation best practices, and relevant testing tools.

Mandatory skill sets:

  • Strong hands-on experience in test automation using Playwright for web applications.
  • Proficient in Java Script/Type Script and able to write modular, maintainable test scripts.
  • Experience working with multiple browser testing (Chromium, Firefox, Web Kit) and cross-platform automation.
  • Solid understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, DOM, HTTP, REST APIs).
  • Experience integrating Playwright tests with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, Git Hub Actions, or similar.
  • Knowledge of setting up and maintaining test automation frameworks and libraries.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and participating actively in sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and debug automation scripts and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.

Preferred skill sets:

  • Experience with other test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Test Cafe is a plus.
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, or C# for test automation.

jobDescription:
Job Profile: At Pw C, our people in corporate affairs and communications are responsible for managing and coordinating the organisation's internal and external communications, public relations, and corporate reputation. They focus on developing and implementing strategies to effectively communicate the organisation's mission, values, and initiatives to various stakeholders including employees, customers, investors, media, and the general public. In public relations at Pw C, you will focus on managing and enhancing the Firm's reputation through strategic communication and media relations. You will build strong relationships with stakeholders and promote the Firm's brand and values.

RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic Media & Reputation Management

· Lead the development and execution of a proactive, narrative-driven media strategy aligned with Pw C India’s brand priorities and business agenda.

· Drive a shift from transactional, announcement-led PR to thematic storytelling that builds long-term brand equity.

· Develop and execute a digital-first PR strategy that complements traditional media efforts and expands Pw C’s presence across online platforms.

· Own Pw C India’s reputation management in the media, ensuring consistency, credibility, and responsiveness.

· Define and track success metrics beyond volume—focusing on quality of coverage, share of voice, narrative penetration, and influence among key audiences.

---

Campaigns & Thought Leadership Amplification

· Translate Pw C’s strategic priorities (AI, trust, policy, economic growth) into compelling media narratives.

· Work closely with leadership to craft opinion pieces, interviews, and commentary that shape public discourse.

· Ensure Pw C is seen not just as a services firm, but as a voice of authority on India’s most critical issues.

· Partner with marketing teams to amplify brand campaigns (e.g., ‘So You Can’, ‘Value in Motion’, AI Edge) through earned media.

· Work closely with business stakeholders to proactively identify themes, insights, and client stories that can be taken to media—and equally bring back media trends, opportunities, and narratives to shape internal priorities and positioning.

Media Relations & Network Building

· Build and nurture strong relationships with top-tier business, policy, and mainstream media across print, digital, and broadcast.

· Identify and cultivate new-age media platforms, influential journalists, and emerging voices.

· Drive consistent, high-quality coverage that enhances Pw C’s visibility among CEOs, policymakers, and stakeholders.

---

Leadership Positioning & Visibility

· Design and execute media engagement plans for senior leadership, including the Chairperson and key partners.

· Secure high-impact opportunities such as interviews, editorial features, TV appearances, and panel participation.

· Ensure leaders are positioned as credible, forward-thinking voices on relevant themes.

· Enable and institutionalise media readiness by designing and conducting structured media training sessions for partners and senior leaders—building their confidence, clarity of messaging, and ability to engage effectively with media.

---

Issues & Crisis Communications

· Support the development of crisis communication frameworks and manage sensitive issues in coordination with leadership.

· Provide real-time counsel on media risks, narratives, and responses.

· Ensure preparedness and consistency in handling high-stakes situations.

Mandatory skill sets:

· Strong understanding of India’s media landscape, including business, policy, and digital ecosystems.

· Proven track record of building leadership visibility and delivering high-impact media outcomes.

· Experience in handling complex, reputation-sensitive environments is strongly preferred.

Preferred skill sets: · Ability to operate in a fast-paced, matrixed organization and influence senior stakeholders.

· Excellent writing, storytelling, and interpersonal skills.

Years of experience required: 14–17 years of experience in media relations, public relations, or strategic communications (agency or corporate).

Education qualification: Bachelor’s degree in communications, Journalism, Public Relations, or related field; Master’s preferred.

Job Description & Summary:

A career in Finance, within Internal Firm Services, will provide you with the opportunity to help Pw C in all aspects of our Finance internal function including financial planning and reporting, data analysis, and assisting leadership with overall strategy. You’ll focus on recording and analysing financial transactions, paying and receiving invoices, maintaining financial statement ledger accounts, and preparing analysis and reconciliations of bills to detect fraud.


Responsibilities

  • Maintain strong business relations with engagement teams and stakeholders.
  • Review and produce analytical reports to support monthly collection targets and daily monitoring.
  • Provide decision support to business units, understanding financial implications.
  • Exercise judgment within policies to resolve customer issues with a client-centric approach.
  • Manage business problems independently with minimal escalation to senior management.
  • Supervise team, assign tasks, review work, and ensure proper documentation.
  • Resolve sensitive and confidential issues promptly as per established procedures.
  • Prepare and ensure timely submission of monthly reports for CFO, Financial Controller, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders.
  • Control and quality check Accounts Receivable activities.
  • Review monthly schedules, collection follow-ups, 26AS reports, and other key periodic reports with attention to detail.
  • Ensure smooth monthly closing activities, including period closure and opening.
  • Assist in bank reconciliations and clearing open items.
  • Ensure timely provisioning for doubtful and bad debts.
  • Identify process, technology, and procedure issues; recommend and implement improvements.
  • Drive technological enhancements and automation to improve efficiency.
  • Stay updated on best market practices and embed them within the team.
  • Communicate process updates and changes regularly to the team.
  • Collaborate effectively with other finance functions, providing and requesting necessary information.
  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of RCSA, KQIs, and statutory requirements.
  • Address audit points efficiently and avoid escalations.
  • Manage business-as-usual (BAU) activities with high accuracy and no escalations.
  • Report WHT certificate data timely to Line of Service when certificates are delayed.
  • Prepare/review financial reports as per guidelines from Manager/Financial Controller.
  • Support continuous process improvement to enable more value-added activities by the team.

Mandatory skill sets:

Accounts Receivable.Team Management

Preferred skill sets:

Finance Operations

Years of experience required:

10+ years

Education qualification:

B.Com, BBA, MBA, M.Com, PGDEducation Level: Graduate – B.com/ BBA / Bachelor’s degree

Post Graduate - MBA/PGDM (Finance), M.Com with strong accounting skills

Job Position Title:

IN_Manager_Data Engineer(Databricks+Guidewire)_D&A_Advisory_Mumbai

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Senior Data Engineer (Databricks | Insurance | Data Lakehouse)


Location: Mumbai (Preferred) / Bangalore

Experience: 7–12 years

Start: Immediate Joiner Preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Manager / Manager /Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in Databricks data management, logical & physical data modelling, and insurance domain data workflows. The candidate will work on a strategic data migration initiative for a leading UK-based insurance company, moving data from Guidewire into Databricks Silver and Gold layers with strong governance, lineage, and scalability standards.

Key Responsibilities

· Databricks Data Engineering & Management

· Design, build, and optimize Silver and Gold layer data pipelines in Databricks using Py Spark, SQL, Delta Lake, and Workflow orchestration.

· Implement data quality, lineage, schema evolution, and governance controls across curated layers.

· Optimize Databricks jobs for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

· Guidewire → Databricks Migration

· Lead the end-to-end migration of large-scale insurance data from Guidewire Policy Center/Claim Center/Billing Center into Databricks.

· Map and transform complex Guidewire entity structures into normalized and star-schema models.

· Data Modelling & Architecture

· Develop robust logical and physical data models aligned to insurance business processes.

· Build high-quality curated data marts (Gold) for analytics, reporting, pricing, underwriting, and claims.

· Define standards for metadata, naming conventions, partitioning, and model documentation.

· Insurance Domain Expertise

· Understand core insurance data entities such as policy, claims, billing, customer, underwriting, rating, and product hierarchies.

· Apply domain knowledge to rationalize Guidewire data structures and create business-ready datasets.

· Solutioning & Ideation

· Collaborate with client SMEs, architects, and business analysts to shape data solutions and propose design improvements.

· Ability to ** ideate, simplify complex data flows**, and contribute to overall solution architecture.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical

7–12 years of experience in data engineering, data modelling, and data management.

Strong hands-on experience in Databricks, Delta Lake, Py Spark, Spark SQL, and ETL/ELT pipelines.

Expertise in logical & physical data modelling (3NF, Star Schema, Data Vault preferred).

Practical knowledge of Guidewire data model and prior migration experience (mandatory).

Experience working with large-scale insurance datasets

Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and governance.

Soft Skills

Strong problem-solving and conceptualization / ideation capability.

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management for UK client environment.

Ability to work in fast-paced delivery tracks with cross-functional global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications in Databricks, Azure/AWS, and Data Warehousing are added advantages.

Experience delivering enterprise-grade data lakes or lakehouse architectures.

Data Engineer, Databricks,

Preferred skill sets:

Guidewire

Years of experience required:

8 to 12 years

B.E/B.Tech/MBA/M.E/M.Tech

At Pw C, our people in data and analytics focus on leveraging data to drive insights and make informed business decisions. They utilise advanced analytics techniques to help clients optimise their operations and achieve their strategic goals.

In business intelligence at Pw C, you will focus on leveraging data and analytics to provide strategic insights and drive informed decision-making for clients. You will develop and implement innovative solutions to optimize business performance and enhance competitive advantage.

Job Position Title:

IN_Manager_Data Engineer(Databricks+Guidewire)_D&A_Advisory_Pune

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Senior Data Engineer (Databricks | Insurance | Data Migration)

Experience: 7–12 years

Start: Immediate Joiner Preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Manager / Manager /Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in Databricks data management, logical & physical data modelling, and insurance domain data workflows. The candidate will work on a strategic data migration initiative for a leading UK-based insurance company, moving data from Guidewire into Databricks Silver and Gold layers with strong governance, lineage, and scalability standards.

Key Responsibilities

Databricks Data Engineering & Management

Design, build, and optimize Silver and Gold layer data pipelines in Databricks using Py Spark, SQL, Delta Lake, and Workflow orchestration.

Implement data quality, lineage, schema evolution, and governance controls across curated layers.

Optimize Databricks jobs for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

Guidewire → Databricks Migration

Lead the end-to-end migration of large-scale insurance data from Guidewire Policy Center/Claim Center/Billing Center into Databricks.

Map and transform complex Guidewire entity structures into normalized and star-schema models.

Data Modelling & Architecture

Develop robust logical and physical data models aligned to insurance business processes.

Build high-quality curated data marts (Gold) for analytics, reporting, pricing, underwriting, and claims.

Define standards for metadata, naming conventions, partitioning, and model documentation.

Insurance Domain Expertise

Understand core insurance data entities such as policy, claims, billing, customer, underwriting, rating, and product hierarchies.

Apply domain knowledge to rationalize Guidewire data structures and create business-ready datasets.

Solutioning & Ideation

Collaborate with client SMEs, architects, and business analysts to shape data solutions and propose design improvements.

Ability to ** ideate, simplify complex data flows**, and contribute to overall solution architecture.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical

7–12 years of experience in data engineering, data modelling, and data management.

Strong hands-on experience in Databricks, Delta Lake, Py Spark, Spark SQL, and ETL/ELT pipelines.

Expertise in logical & physical data modelling (3NF, Star Schema, Data Vault preferred).

Practical knowledge of Guidewire data model and prior migration experience (mandatory).

Experience working with large-scale insurance datasets

Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and governance.

Mandatory skill sets:

Databricks+Guidewire

Preferred skill sets:

Databricks+Guidewire

Years of experience required:

7—10Years

Education qualification:

B.E/B.Tech/MBA/M.E/M.Tech

Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is looking for an experienced Data Governance Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in implementing enterprise Data Governance frameworks and managing Collibra platform solutions. The consultant will be responsible for designing, implementing, and enhancing Data Governance Operating Models, policies, standards, and workflows aligned with industry best practices (DCAM, DAMA). This role involves close collaboration with business and IT stakeholders to enable effective data quality, metadata management, and master data governance using Collibra and other enterprise systems. Job Position Title: IN_Manager_Data Governance_Collibra_D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and implement enterprise Data Governance frameworks, operating models, policies, standards, and processes aligned with industry best practices (DCAM, DAMA).
  • Define Data Governance operating models including council structures, RACI matrices, and roles for Data Owners, Data Stewards, and Data Custodians.
  • Conduct Data Governance maturity assessments and develop client-specific implementation roadmaps.
  • Support business functions in identifying and documenting Critical Data Elements (CDEs), Business Data Quality rules, Business Glossary, hierarchies for master/reference data, and Data Dictionary.
  • Collaborate with Data Owners and Data Stewards to define and monitor Data Quality rules for CDEs across applications such as Workday, Databricks, and other enterprise systems.
  • Design and document business requirements (BRDs) for workflows within Collibra, including Data Quality, Business Glossary, Reference Data, Issue Management, Report Catalog, and oversee end-to-end workflow development.
  • Lead workshops and discussions with CXOs, CDOs, and senior business leaders on Data Governance vision, strategy, and initiatives.
  • Manage and mentor direct reports and project teams providing coaching and career development support.
  • Lead or support the Pw C Data Governance Center of Excellence (Co E) in thought leadership, asset creation, accelerators, and team capability building.
  • Contribute to business development efforts including responding to RFPs/RFIs, proposal writing, client demos, and solution presentations.

Mandatory Skill Sets:

  • 7–10 years overall experience with a minimum of 5 years in the Data Governance domain and consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and configuring Collibra Data Governance and Data Catalog solutions.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing Data Governance operating models, policies, and processes within large enterprises.
  • Proven experience preparing detailed BRDs and driving development for Data Governance areas like Metadata Management, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Quality, and Master Data Management.
  • Strong ability to lead C-suite discussions (CXO/CDO) on Data Governance strategy, business cases, and ROI.
  • Experience leading and mentoring delivery teams in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as per project/client needs.

Preferred Skill Sets:

  • Experience working with data catalog and metadata management tools such as Microsoft Purview, Informatica Enterprise Data Catalog, and Alation is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ETL and data integration tools like Informatica Power Center, Talend, or Azure Data Factory in support of Data Governance initiatives.

Education Qualification: BE, B.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Tech


Years of Experience Required: 7 - 10 years

• Work with senior leadership on proposals, SOWs, and client relationships.

• ~7–10 years overall, with substantial hands-on and leadership experience in Gen AI, AI / ML, or related delivery.

• Solid full-stack and cloud skills, with strong knowledge of at least one cloud platform and working knowledge of the others.

• Strong client-facing skills: communication, stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, and presenting work clearly.

• Business judgement to connect technology to business value, cost, and adoption.

• Experience taking Gen AI systems from prototype to production with SLAs and cost controls.

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, multimodal solutions, and LLMOps / Fin Ops for Gen AI.

• Consulting background and experience in regulated industries.

• Cloud certifications (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer).

• Experience in a consulting or client-facing delivery role, and a track record of upskilling teams

· Cloud & AI Platforms: Azure (Open AI, AI Foundry, AI Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sage Maker), GCP (Vertex AI, Gemini, Agent Builder)

· LLMs & SLMs: GPT-4o/5, Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.x, Gemini 2.x, Llama 3.x, Mistral / Mixtral, Phi, Qwen, Deep Seek, Command R+

· Agent Frameworks: Lang Graph, Lang Chain, Llama Index, Crew AI, Auto Gen, Semantic Kernel, MCP

title: Manager Test Automation Engineer Agentic Automation Advisory Mumbai (India)
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

We’re hiring a hands-on Test Automation Engineer who understands modern automated testing across UI, API/back-end, performance, security and critically - testing of LLM-driven/agentic automations and conversational agents. This person will build, run and own automated test suites end-to-end, validate agent behaviors, and work with product & engineering teams to maintain high quality in increasingly agent-enabled systems.

Job Position Title:

IN_Manager_Test Automation Engineer _Agentic Automation_Advisory_Mumbai (India)

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design, develop and maintain automated test suites for UI, API, backend systems and conversational agents (LLM-based agents).

  • Create and own JMeter scripts for performance, load, stress and endurance testing; analyse results and recommend tuning.

  • Test and validate agentic workflows: multi-step agent conversations, orchestration between agents, failure modes, recovery and escalation flows.

  • Validate conversational AI / chatbots using frameworks/tools such as Botium, Dialogflow, Test My Bot (or equivalents): intent recognition, slot-filling, conversation flows, fallback handling and NLU accuracy.

  • Perform UI/UX validation: visual consistency, navigation flows, accessibility checks, and cross-browser/device behaviour (use Browser Stack, Katalon or similar).

  • Build and maintain regression suites (Selenium / Katalon / Playwright)

  • Develop automated API test suites (Postman / REST-assured / custom scripts) and validate API SLAs, response correctness, and performance.

  • Integrate tests with CI/CD (Jenkins/Git Lab/Azure Dev Ops) and produce actionable dashboards and test reports.

  • Triage defects, collaborate with devs/product on fixes, and re-run automated pipelines to validate fixes.

  • Drive continuous improvement: enhance automation coverage, introduce best practices for testing agentic systems, and document test strategy.

Mandatory skill sets:

  • 7–12 years of experience in software testing with strong automation exposure.

  • Proven hands-on experience with Apache JMeter for performance/load testing.

  • Solid experience building functional automation using Selenium, Katalon or equivalent frameworks.

  • Experience testing conversational agents / chatbots / voice bots using tools like Botium, Dialogflow, Test My Bot or similar.

  • Familiarity with LLM/agent testing concepts: prompt/capability testing, hallucination detection, safety checks, conversation drift, and chain-of-thought evaluation.

  • Comfortable writing code/scripts in Java / Python / Java Script / Groovy for automation tasks.

  • Experience integrating tests with CI/CD pipelines and generating meaningful dashboards/reports.

Preferred skill sets:

Apache JMeter , conversational agents / chatbots / voice bots

Years of experience required:

7- 12 years

Education qualification:

BE/ Btech/ Mtech/ MCA/ MBA (fulltime)

title: Senior Associate
jobDescription:
Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector FS X-Sector Specialism Operations Management Level Senior Associate Job Description & Summary A career within Application and Emerging Technology services, will provide you with a unique opportunity to help our clients identify and prioritise emerging technologies that can help solve their business problems. We help clients design approaches to integrate new technologies, skills, and processes so they can get the most out of their technology investment and drive business results and innovation. Responsibilities As a Senior Associate, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to: Proactively assist in the management of several clients, while reporting to Managers and above Train and lead staff Establish effective working relationships directly with clients Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical acumen Keep up to date with local and national business and economic issues Be actively involved in business development activities to help identify and research opportunities on new/existing clients Continue to develop internal relationships and your Pw C brand Looking for IT strategy/ Consulting position
- (Payment Architect)
- Sr Consultant Responsibilities
1. Lead complex transformation projects from strategy and design to delivery phase
2. Actively participate in cross-functional, cross -discipline architecture teams to enhance/setarchitectural direction for key business initiatives
3. Manage trade-offs to speed to market, quality and business/financial impacts
4. Technical leadership across a broad scale of tools, technologies, testing methodologies andarchitecture models
5. Effectively communicate designs/ solutions in multiple forums and to various audiences including CXOs of banks and financial service
6. Develop and lead proposals/RFPs in collaboration with network firms Required Skills (must have) 1) At least 5 -7 years of experience in payments and technology architecture 2) Governance and oversight projects/processes for managing alignment of change to strategic goals 3) Problem solving skills and experience in handling complex transformation projects 4) Broad based knowledge and experience in P2P/B2B/B2C/G2P payments applications, channels, Message specs such as ISO 20022, ISO 8583 etc., Middleware/integration, databases and servers/san storages 5) Strong knowledge on cloud and on-prem infrastructure, data and payments security (PCI DSS/PA DSS compliance) Desired Skills
1. Proactive leadership capabilities
2. Should be able to drive and lead design and implementation projects
3. Should have at least 1 -2 years of International experience in handling/managing paymentstransformation projects
4. Industry best practices in architectural methodologies and standards ( eg: TOGAF, Zachmann, Rational Unified Process etc..) Preferred Experience 5
- 10 years (primarily in IT consulting) Preferred Certification At least one of the below: TOGAF PMP CSM ITIL (Master/ intermediate) AWS certified solution Architect Target Companies Big 4 firms, TCS, DXC, Accenture, IBM Education (if blank, degree and/or field of study not specified) Degrees/Field of Study required: Degrees/Field of Study preferred: Certifications (if blank, certifications not specified) Required Skills Optional Skills Desired Languages (If blank, desired languages not specified) Travel Requirements Up to 40% Available for Work Visa Sponsorship? No Government Clearance Required? No Job Posting End Date

Digital Strategy Consultant/Senior Consultant
As a Senior Consultant in a Digital Strategy role at Pw C India, your aim is threefold: to support clients throughout the discover, design, and target state phases of (digital) strategy engagements. You work with a team of consultants on the topic of digital strategy: focused on delivery of projects, internal knowledge sharing and overall practice support. Finally, you are also willing to engage on the topic from a commercial perspective. In conjoint effort with the rest of the senior management team, you support in the development of new business proposals. Job Description & Summary: We are looking for an experienced AWS Data Engineer with strong expertise in SQL, Python, and Py Spark to design, build, and optimize scalable data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines. The role requires hands-on experience with AWS services such as Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, and DMS, along with a strong understanding of data engineering best practices, production readiness, and high-volume data processing.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS services such as Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, and DMS. Implement direct-to-Aurora ingestion strategies for snapshots and delta loads. Ensure referential integrity, correct processing order, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms. Build monitoring, validation, and reconciliation frameworks for production data pipelines. Manage scalability and throughput during high-volume EOD ingestion workloads. Mandatory skill sets: Expert-level SQL development and performance optimization. Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Py Spark . Hands-on experience with ETL pipelines and orchestration frameworks. Solid understanding of ACID-compliant data ingestion principles. Experience with schema evolution and CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns. Experience owning production readiness and end-to-end solution delivery. Exposure to cloud-native architectures and AWS tools such as Glue, Step Functions, Lambda, and DMS. Preferred skill sets: Experience with SAP ODP or enterprise data replication technologies. Familiarity with distributed Postgre SQL systems. Exposure to event-driven architectures such as Kafka. Years of experience required: Experience : 5–8 years Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in data engineering, data integration, or related roles. Proven track record of building resilient and idempotent ingestion frameworks. Experience supporting high-volume, time-sensitive processing, especially EOD workloads. Strong operational mindset, including monitoring, alerting, and maintaining runbooks. Job Description & Summary: We are looking for a skilled Gen AI / Agentic AI Developer with strong Python expertise to design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and Agentic AI applications using both open-source frameworks and cloud-native AI services. The ideal candidate should be capable of modernizing existing applications into microservices-based architectures, building intelligent autonomous AI solutions, and making cost-effective AI decisions by leveraging custom ML models and Small Language Models (SLMs) where LLM usage is expensive.

Job Position Title: IN_ Senior Associate_ Agentic AI Developer_ Emerging Businesses _Advisory_ Gurugram

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and develop Gen AI and Agentic AI applications using open-source and cloud-native tools

  • Build autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool usage, and multi-step task execution

  • Modernize legacy/monolithic applications into microservices-based architecture

  • Implement RAG pipelines and knowledge-grounded AI systems

  • Deploy and orchestrate AI workloads using cloud-native services (AWS / GCP / Azure)

  • Develop APIs and microservices using Python (Fast API / Django)

  • Build and train custom ML models for use cases like demand forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictions where LLM operations are costly or overkill

  • Evaluate and implement Small Language Models (SLMs) as cost-effective alternatives to LLMs for specific tasks

  • Implement observability, guardrails, and evaluation frameworks for AI applications

jobDescription:
At Pw C, our people in data and analytics focus on leveraging data to drive insights and make informed business decisions. They utilise advanced analytics techniques to help clients optimise their operations and achieve their strategic goals.

In business intelligence at Pw C, you will focus on leveraging data and analytics to provide strategic insights and drive informed decision-making for clients. You will develop and implement innovative solutions to optimize business performance and enhance competitive advantage.

Job Position Title:

IN_Senior Associate_Azure Databricks_D&A_Advisory_Kolkata

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Role Summary

Senior data engineer responsible for designing scalable Databricks lakehouse architecture, data modelling, reusable ETL frameworks, automation, and performance engineering.

Required Skills

· B.Tech/B.E degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.

· 5-6+ years in Data Engineering; 3+ years in Databricks

· Deep expertise in Spark SQL, Py Spark, Python, Delta Lake

· Strong cloud experience (AWS / Azure / GCP)

· CI/CD implementation for data platforms

· Strong performance tuning and workload optimization

· Experience designing large-scale ETL pipeline

· Strong understanding on SQL and data modeling skills

Good to Have

· Experience with Gen AI/Agentic AI for code conversion, automation, or metadata generation

· Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Cloud Formation)

· Experience integrating on-prem DBs (Teradata/Oracle) with cloud

Key Responsibilities

· Design Databricks Lakehouse medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)

· Architect reusable ingestion & transformation frameworks using Databricks and Enterprise level ETL / orchestration tool.

· Preparing Physical data Model

· Design and develop ingestion pipelines for various type of sources – RDBMS, API, Files, etc.

· Experience in writing code to transform variety data formats (structured, unstructured, and semi-structured) to uniform formats.

· Define CI/CD and Dev Ops automation strategy

· Implement RBAC for various user persona by Unity catalog

· Define clustering, scaling, and performance strategies

Mandatory skill sets:

Azure Databricks

Preferred skill sets:

Azure Databricks

Years of experience required:

4-8 Years

Education qualification:

B.E/B.Tech/MBA/M.E/M.Tech

title: Senior Associate Collibra D&A Advisory PAN India
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is looking for a highly skilled Collibra Data Governance Consultant with hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, and customizing Collibra Data Governance and Data Catalog solutions. This is a purely technical role focused on deploying, integrating, and enhancing Collibra platform capabilities to support enterprise data governance and master data management processes.

Job Position Title: IN_Senior Associate_Collibra_D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and implement technical solutions within the Collibra platform, focusing on data governance, data cataloging, policy management, and workflow automation.
  • Configure and customize Collibra assets including domains, communities, business glossaries, policies, workflows, and reports to meet business requirements.
  • Develop integrations between Collibra and other enterprise systems (e.g., data lakes, data warehouses, ETL tools) using REST APIs, webhooks, and Collibra Connect.
  • Implement and maintain data stewardship workflows and lifecycle management processes within Collibra platform.
  • Conduct technical analysis of data governance and master data management needs and translate them into scalable Collibra solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to data governance workflows, cataloging jobs, API integrations, and metadata management.
  • Collaborate closely with data governance teams, data stewards, and business users to understand policies and translate them into technical implementations within Collibra.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation including design documents, configuration manuals, and test cases.
  • Integrate Collibra with other data catalog and governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Informatica Enterprise Data Catalog, and Alation to ensure a seamless metadata management ecosystem.
  • Stay updated with Collibra product features and best practices, as well as developments in complementary platforms like Purview, Informatica, Alation, and overall Data Catalog technologies.

Mandatory skill sets:

  • Hands-on experience in implementing and configuring Collibra Data Governance and Data Catalog platform capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance frameworks, data cataloging, policy management, and stewardship workflows in Collibra.
  • Experience in developing and managing Collibra custom workflows using Collibra Workflow Engine and process automation.
  • Expertise in integrating Collibra with external systems via REST APIs, Collibra Connect, or similar tools for metadata ingestion and synchronization.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and optimize Collibra platform performance and configuration.
  • Familiarity with metadata management, data lineage, and data quality concepts within the Collibra ecosystem.

Preferred skill sets:

  • Experience working with data catalog and metadata management platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Informatica Enterprise Data Catalog, Alation, or similar tools.
  • Experience with ETL, data integration tools such as Informatica Power Center, Talend, or Azure Data Factory in conjunction with data governance implementations.

Years of experience required: 4-7 Years

Education qualification: BE, B.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Tech

title: Senior Associate Data Engineer D&A Advisory PAN India
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is seeking a proficient Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Snowflake, Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions. This role involves working within complex data ecosystems to enable data warehousing, analytics, and enterprise data management, ultimately driving data-driven decision-making and business efficiency.

Job Position Title: IN_Senior Associate_Data Engineer_D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows using Snowflake and IICS across cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Architect and implement cloud data warehousing solutions, ensuring best practices in data modeling, performance optimization, and security.
  • Collaborate with data architects, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust data engineering solutions.
  • Develop and maintain automated data ingestion, transformation, and integration processes from diverse data sources into Snowflake and cloud data lakes.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance, ensuring data quality, reliability, and consistency.
  • Implement cloud native data management solutions leveraging Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Google Cloud Dataflow, or equivalent services in conjunction with IICS.
  • Establish data governance, metadata management, and data lineage using available cloud and ETL tools.
  • Document data flow processes, pipeline architectures, and technical designs to facilitate knowledge sharing and compliance.
  • Stay updated with emerging cloud data technologies and recommend improvements to existing data engineering processes.

Mandatory skill sets:

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake for data warehousing, including performance tuning, clustering, and security.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically related to data engineering services.
  • Expertise in Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) or similar cloud-based ETL tools for data integration workflows.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, data pipeline architecture, and ETL/ELT best practices.
  • Proficient in SQL and scripting languages like Python, Shell, or similar for automation and orchestration of data workflows.
  • Experience with cloud-native orchestration and monitoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance standards in cloud environments.

Preferred skill sets:

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes) for deploying data engineering solutions.
  • Knowledge of Big Data ecosystem tools (Apache Spark, Kafka) and cloud-native data lake architectures.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates for cloud resource provisioning.
  • Working knowledge of Dev Ops practices and CI/CD pipelines in data engineering context.
  • Prior experience in industry domains such as finance, healthcare, or retail for contextual data solutions.

Years of experience required: 4-7 Years

Education qualification: BE, B.Tech, MCA, MBA, M.Tech

This involves analysing workforce trends, applying the latest HR strategy, long-term workforce planning and improving overall employee experience. In business partnering at Pw C, you will focus on strategic consulting with business stakeholders, advising on people strategies, policies and programmes to achieve current and future business objectives and overcome people related challenges. You will work collaboratively with the wider HR team to shape the Firm’s people strategy and priorities based on their understanding of the business as well as influence the business alignment with and adoption of firmwide direction.

Job Role:
The Senior Associate– Employee Relations will act as a strategic partner to the business and HR leadership, responsible for managing complex employee relations matters, conducting investigations, advising leadership on people risk, and ensuring compliance with employment laws and organizational policies.

This role plays a critical part in maintaining a fair, compliant, and high-trust workplace by managing high-risk ER cases, advising senior leaders, strengthening ER governance frameworks, and driving proactive employee relations initiatives across the organization.
RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Employee Relations Case Management
• Lead and resolve complex and high-risk employee relations cases including misconduct, grievance, performance disputes, disciplinary actions,
• Conduct end-to-end workplace investigations/ due diligence including fact-finding, interviews, documentation, and recommendation of corrective actions.
• Ensure consistent application of policies and procedures while maintaining fairness, confidentiality, and legal compliance.

2. Advisory to Business Leaders
• Serve as a trusted advisor to HR Business Partners, senior leadership, and people managers on employee relations matters.
• Provide guidance on disciplinary processes, performance management, terminations, restructuring, and sensitive employee issues.
• Assist HC leader to Coach leaders on conflict resolution, difficult conversations, and people management practices.

3. Risk Management & Compliance
• Ensure adherence to employment laws, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
• Identify, assess, and mitigate employee-related risks across business units.
• Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Ethics teams on complex investigations or litigation risks.

4. ER Framework, Governance & Policy
• Support the design and implementation of ER governance frameworks, processes, and policies across the organization.
• Drive consistent ER practices across service lines and business units.
• Conduct periodic reviews of policies to ensure compliance with labor laws and evolving workplace standards.

5. Organizational Change & Workforce Matters
• Support business restructuring, workforce transitions, redundancy processes, and organizational changes.
• Provide ER support during large-scale workforce actions or sensitive business changes.

6. Capability Building & Training
• Develop and deliver ER training programs for HR teams, managers, and leadership.
• Educate stakeholders on ER processes, investigation protocols, and employment law updates.

7. Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement
• Analyze ER case trends and employee issues to identify systemic risks.
• Provide insights and recommendations to leadership to improve workplace culture and prevent recurring issues.

Stakeholder Management

The role works closely with:
• HR Business Partners
• Business Unit Leaders / Partners
• Legal and Compliance teams &
Ethics & Business Conduct
• Global ER teams
• External counsel or regulatory bodies (if required)

Mandatory skill sets:

• Employee relations and workplace investigations
• Conflict resolution and grievance handling
• Employment law and regulatory compliance
• Stakeholder management and executive advisory

Preferred skill sets:

• High emotional intelligence and judgment
• Risk management and governance
• Confidential case handling and documentation
Years of experience required:
5+ years of experience in Employee Relations / HR / HRBP roles.

Education qualification:

Postgraduate degree in HR / Industrial Relations / Law / MBA (HR) preferred

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Proactive approach to new challenges.

Preferred Skill Sets:

  • Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or MBA in Finance.

Years of Experience Required: 4–6 years in finance operations

Education Qualification: Professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or MBA in Finance preferred.

title: Senior Associate Gen AI developer Emerging Business Advisory Bangalore (India)
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

Pw C India is a leading professional services firm helping organizations solve complex business problems. Within Pw C, the Emerging Businesses unit acts as the incubation and innovation engine. We focus on building next-generation digital products, platforms, and enterprise solutions using disruptive technologies.

As a Gen AI Developer in this team, you will work at the intersection of business strategy and cutting-edge technology. You will design and implement state-of-the-art Generative AI solutions that drive transformation for Pw C and our marquee clients across diverse industries.

Job Position Title:

IN_Senior Associate_Gen AI developer _Emerging Business_Advisory_Bangalore (India)

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Solution Development: Develop and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI applications, APIs, and microservices.

· LLM Orchestration & RAG: Optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and advanced search architectures to ground LLMs on proprietary enterprise data.

· Agentic AI: Build multi-agent systems and autonomous workflows using orchestration frameworks to automate complex, multi-step business processes.

· Model Integration: Integrate leading commercial and foundational models via enterprise cloud environments (Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock, or GCP Vertex AI / Model Garden).

· Responsible AI & Guardrails: Implement safety guidelines, content moderation, data privacy controls, and guardrails to ensure compliant and ethical AI deployments. Establish evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance (latency, accuracy, bias, drift, and cost) and set up monitoring in production.

· Client Collaboration & Po Cs: Rapidly prototype Proof of Concepts (Po Cs) to showcase Gen AI capabilities to internal leaders and external clients.

Mandatory skill sets:

· 3–6 years of experience in software development with strong computer science fundamentals.

· Expert Python Programming: Deep proficiency in Python and its standard libraries.

· API Development: Experience building robust and secure RESTful/Graph QL APIs using frameworks like Fast API, Flask, or Django.

· Cloud Ecosystems (Any One Preferred): Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform’s AI ecosystem:

· GCP: Vertex AI, Vertex AI Search and Conversation, Vertex AI Model Garden, Gemini API, Google ADK.

· Microsoft Azure: Azure Open AI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, AI Foundry

· AWS: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Sage Maker.

· Databases: Proficiency in SQL and No SQL databases.

· Frameworks: Extensive experience with Lang Chain, Llama Index or Lang Graph.

· Vector Databases & Search: Practical experience with vector databases/search engines such as Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, Vertex AI Vector Search, or Azure AI Search.

· Prompt Engineering: Proven ability in designing complex system prompts, few-shot learning, and chain-of-thought prompting.

· Embeddings: Deep understanding of text embeddings, semantic search, and advanced chunking strategies.

· 3. Dev Ops & LLMOps

· Containerization using Docker and basic understanding of Kubernetes (e.g., GKE, AKS, or EKS).

· Experience with Git-based CI/CD pipelines.

· Familiarity with LLM monitoring tools (e.g., Lang Smith, Langfuse or Arize Phoenix).

Preferred skill sets:

· Experience in Fine-tuning models (PEFT, Lo RA) using Hugging Face libraries.

· Knowledge of Graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) for Graph RAG implementations.

· Familiarity with UI prototyping frameworks like Streamlit, Chainlit, or Gradio.

· An understanding of MLOps pipelines on GCP (Vertex AI Pipelines), Azure, or AWS.

Years of experience required:

· 4- 7 years

Education qualification:

· BE/ Btech/ Mtech/ MCA/ MBA (fulltime)

title: Senior Associate GenAI Developers Alliances IFS Gurgaon/Bangalore
jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary:

As an Associate or Senior Associate in the Gen AI Experience Lab, you will design and build generative AI solutions aligned with our priority sectors and competencies. You will work hands-on across the full stack, using modern Gen AI techniques and AI-assisted tools to build and ship working software. Building proofs of concept is a secondary part of the role, used to test ideas before they are taken forward. You will also support client workshops and internal upskilling with demos and reusable components.

Pw C India's Gen AI Experience Lab designs and builds generative AI solutions for clients in the sectors and competencies the firm focuses on. We also run workshops to train client and internal teams on Gen AI, and build proofs of concept to test ideas before they are taken forward.

Job Position Title:

IN_Senior Associate_Gen AI Developers_Alliances_IFS_Gurgaon/Bangalore

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and build Gen AI solutions aligned with priority sectors and competencies, from problem definition to deployable software.

  • Develop full stack applications: front-end (React/Next.js, Type Script) and back-end/APIs (Python Fast API and/or Node).

  • Implement core Gen AI patterns: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, streaming, model integration.

  • Build retrieval layers including chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking; set up vector databases and knowledge graphs.

  • Integrate model providers and cloud AI services (Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and open-weight models.

  • Build agent workflows using Lang Chain, Llama Index, Lang Graph or Crew AI.

  • Utilize AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, v0, Lovable, Bolt, Replit.

  • Build proofs of concept and demos to test ideas and support client conversations.

  • Support client workshops and internal upskilling with demos, sample apps, and reusable components.

Mandatory skill sets:

• ~3–8 years in software development, with at least 3 years hands-on building Gen AI solutions and POCs.

• Strong full-stack skills: front-end (React / Next.js, Type Script) and back-end (Python Fast API and/or Node), REST / Graph QL.

• Hands-on experience building Gen AI applications: RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, function and tool calling, and at least one agent framework.

• Practical experience using AI-assisted / vibe-coding tools.

• Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure / AWS / GCP) and its AI services.

• Comfortable with Git, Docker, and standard development workflows.

Preferred skill sets:

• Experience with advanced RAG (re-ranking, Graph RAG, agentic RAG) and multi-agent patterns.

• Experience with document AI or vision (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, GPT-4o / Gemini vision).

• Familiarity with LLMOps and evaluation tooling (Lang Smith, Lang Fuse, MLflow), and cloud certifications.

• Experience supporting client demos or workshops.

Years of experience required:

3–8 years total software development experience, with 3+ years specifically in Gen AI development.

Education qualification:

  • B.Tech in Computer Science / IT (preferred).

  • MBA in a related field from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 institute (IIM, ISB, XLRI, FMS, MDI) is an added advantage.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to clients and internal teams.

Tech Stack You'll Work With

· Languages & Frameworks: Python (Fast API, Pydantic), Type Script / Node, React / Next.js, SQL

· LLMs & APIs: GPT-5+, Claude Opus/Sonnet, Gemini 2.x, Llama 3.x, Mistral; function/tool calling, JSON-mode, streaming

· Gen AI Frameworks: Lang Chain, Llama Index, Lang Graph, Crew AI

· RAG & Retrieval: Embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking; Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, Chroma, Neo4j

· Cloud & AI Services: Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI (one primary; exposure to others)

· AI-Assisted Dev (Vibe Coding): Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, v0, Lovable, Bolt, Replit

· Dev & Infra: Git, Docker, REST / Graph QL APIs

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Infrastructure professional with a strong foundation in Google Cloud technologies to drive enterprise-grade solutions. jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary: We are seeking a seasoned IICS & Data Migration Lead at the Manager/Senior Manager level to lead, architect, and deliver large-scale data migration and integration programs using Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS). The role goes beyond hands-on development — it requires solution ownership, team leadership, client engagement, estimation, and delivery governance across complex SAP and non-SAP migration programs.

Job Position Title:

IN_Senior Associate_IICS Data Migration _D&A_Advisory_PAN India

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Solution Leadership & Architecture:

  • Own end-to-end solution design and architecture for data migration engagements using IICS (CDI, CAI, Data Quality, Mass Ingestion).

  • Define integration patterns, connector strategies (SAP, JDBC, Flat File, REST/SOAP), and reusable frameworks for large-scale migrations.

  • Establish performance optimization standards (pushdown optimization, partitioning, caching, parallel processing) across the team.

  • Drive technical decisions on migration approach — big bang vs. phased, batch vs. real-time, full vs. incremental loads.

Delivery & Program Management:

  • Lead delivery of multiple concurrent migration workstreams — managing timelines, dependencies, risks, and quality.

  • Own estimation, planning, and resource allocation for migration programs.

  • Define and enforce migration methodology — profiling, source-to-target mapping, cleansing, mock runs, cutover planning, reconciliation, and hypercare.

  • Drive cutover governance — go/no-go decisions, rollback strategies, and stakeholder sign-offs.

  • Establish quality gates, testing frameworks, and reconciliation mechanisms to ensure zero-data-loss migrations.

SAP & Non-SAP Migration Expertise:

  • Provide technical leadership for SAP ECC/S4HANA data extraction (BAPI, RFC, IDoc, CDS Views, BW Extractors) and guide team on ABAP-based extraction logic.

  • Oversee non-SAP migrations from Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, Flat Files, Cloud DBs (Snowflake/Redshift/Big Query), and API-based sources.

  • Resolve complex data dependencies, transformation challenges, and cross-system integration issues.

Team Leadership & Mentoring:

  • Lead and mentor a team of 5–15 IICS developers and migration analysts (Senior Associates and below).

  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and drive best practices adoption across the team.

  • Build team capability through knowledge sharing, training, and structured onboarding of new joiners.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients on migration engagements.

  • Present solution approaches, migration strategies, and progress updates to client leadership (Director/VP level).

  • Manage client expectations, scope changes, and escalations proactively.

  • Collaborate with client-side SAP functional teams, data owners, and IT leadership.

Pre-Sales & Practice Development:

  • Support pre-sales and business development — contribute to proposals, RFP responses, effort estimations, and solution presentations.

  • Develop reusable accelerators, templates, and frameworks for IICS-based migration engagements.

  • Contribute to practice building — thought leadership, internal training, and capability development.

Mandatory skill sets:

  • IICS (Must-Have): 6+ years hands-on + architecture experience with IICS — CDI, CAI, Data Quality, Mass Ingestion, Taskflows, Advanced Mappings & Mapplets, Connectors (SAP, JDBC, Flat File, REST/SOAP), Performance Optimization at scale

  • SAP Migration (Must-Have): Led SAP ECC/S4HANA migration programs; deep understanding of BAPI/RFC/IDoc, CDS Views, BW Extractors; ABAP-level data extraction knowledge

  • Non-SAP Migration (Must-Have): Led migrations from 2+ non-SAP sources: Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, Flat Files, Snowflake/Redshift/Big Query, REST/SOAP APIs

  • Migration Methodology: Proven experience owning and governing end-to-end migration lifecycle across multiple projects

  • SQL: Expert-level SQL — complex querying, reconciliation design, performance tuning

  • Leadership: Experience leading teams of 5–15; mentoring, workload management, quality assurance

  • Client Management: Direct client-facing experience; comfort presenting to senior stakeholders

  • Estimation & Planning: Experience in effort estimation, SOW scoping, and delivery planning

Preferred skill sets:

  • Experience with Informatica Power Center and large-scale Power Center-to-IICS migration programs.

  • Hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and native data services (ADF, Glue, Dataflow).

  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for IICS deployments and Dev Ops practices for data integration.

  • Knowledge of CDC mechanisms, event-driven architecture, and real-time integration patterns.

  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks and tools (Informatica Data Catalog, Collibra).

  • Experience in ERP transformation programs (SAP S/4HANA conversions, greenfield/brownfield implementations).

  • Informatica certifications (IICS Developer / Cloud Data Integration / Data Quality).

  • Prior experience in Big 4 / top-tier consulting firms delivering large migration programs is strongly preferred.

Years of experience required: 5 to 10 years

Education qualification: B.Tech /MBA

We are seeking an experienced Multi-Cloud Platform & Solution Engineer to design and deliver comprehensive end-to-end multi-cloud engineering solutions across AWS and GCP environments. Cloud Foundation & Landing Zones: Design and manage enterprise landing zones on AWS and GCP with IAM baselines, SSO integration, and CIS-aligned organizational policies

Analytics & Data Solutions: Build analytics platforms leveraging Big Query, Looker, and Composer (Airflow) with data ingestion pipelines from AWS, on-premises, and Google Analytics

Disaster Recovery & Observability: Design DR architectures with failover capabilities and establish cloud-native observability including monitoring, logging, dashboards, SLIs/SLOs, and operational runbooks

Cross-Functional Enablement: Partner with stakeholders to translate technical concepts, mentor teams, and drive cloud adoption initiatives across the organization
